records.title: Second-part report of a radio-traffic transfer
records.header_literal: A) BSL v UKS (10.27 p.m., November 30th); 1700 (11/29); (1st Tl Missing); 2 TL RICHI-186
records.readable_german: ?DEZ GROSSW0RDEIN. DNZW uebernimmt Verkehr fuer OKM SCHWEREX9 RUFZ: Natan Adolf Ursula in GROSSVARDEIN.
records.meaning: The surviving second part states that DNZW takes over communications traffic for OKM, followed by the literal field SCHWEREX9 and RUFZ, then the proposed spoken-name sequence Natan Adolf Ursula and a place-like label. RUFZ may abbreviate Rufzeichen, or call sign. The missing first part and the exact identity of DNZW, the station and the location are not reconstructed.
notes: The source explicitly says the first part is missing. This is an edition of the complete native 186-slot second part, not a reconstruction of the missing first part.
Four printed dashes remain occupied source positions. Three are filled in the proposals UR?UL? to URSULA and GRO?SVARDEIN to GROSSVARDEIN. The initial ? is retained with domain {1, 3, D, I, N, U}.
The only observed-coordinate word change is VERKAHR to VERKEHR. Natan Adolf Ursula is an explicit source-mask completion proposal, not an independently identified person or station.
GROSSW0RDEIN keeps the numeral 0 and W in the first place-like field; GROSSVARDEIN keeps V in the second. Neither field is silently normalized to a modern or historical place name.
The initial ?DEZ is not assigned a particular December date. The interception header and separate 11/29 originating line do not select that character.
Y is the separator label. X and 9 inside SCHWEREX9 remain literal; DNZW and RUFZ are not expanded in the exact readable quotation.

prior_credit: Published period keys: George Lasry, Ingo Niebel, Nils Kopal and Arno Wacker (2016), and George Lasry (2017 key list). Earlier repository OCR and unchanged-key outputs are retained separately. Source review and explicit editorial work: icekylinx and GPT-6 Astra Pro. No universal first-decipherment priority is asserted.
limits: All native source slots remain in printed order; no insertion, deletion or reordering.
Unknown square cells remain globally coupled and injective. Roundtrip completion witnesses are explicitly nonhistorical.
Observed-coordinate substitutions and source-mask fills are priced separately. A source-compatible word proposal is not proof of unique historical wording.
